escalation: A normative claim about case, aspect, or pronunciation needs a rank 1 source.
A claim about current usage or register needs a rank 1 or rank 4 source, never AI output alone.
A minimal pair may only be confirmed with audio or phonetic evidence.
prohibited: Copying course-book text or exercises into this pack.
Storing more than a short excerpt of a rights-reserved source.
Presenting AI-generated normative claims as verified.

source_classes.description: PWN dictionaries and usage guides, and the CEFR Companion Volume for descriptors.
Published Polish course books and graded readers.
Polish broadcasters and public-domain literature, used as short excerpts only.
Frequency and collocation evidence from a Polish corpus.
The learner's own utterances and writing, used as evidence rather than as a norm.
